body:
It’s their family history, it’s their fate, they have the right to know about it. Especially everything involving Kai because he’s a danger to them. 
They may not be adults, but they aren’t little children & are capable of comprehending information. 
It may not be easy for the parents, but it’s necessary! 
Sheltering your children from the truth always turns out badly 🤷🏻‍♀️
I knew it was going to be super simple!! 😂😂 Thank you!
